protocols.title: Triptorelin Acetate (2 mg) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. The page does not recommend self-administration. Triptorelin is a potent prescription GnRH agonist with depot formulations used under specialist care; it initially causes a hormone flare then suppresses LH/FSH and sex hormones. Research vial page is not an appropriate dosing guide.

schedule.description: Different approved sustained-release depot formulations: 3.75 mg monthly, 11.25 mg every 3 months, or 22.5 mg every 6 months, clinician-administered. A plain 2 mg research vial is not a depot.
Historical supervised regimen for first week, then lower maintenance; page does not specify the maintenance amount.

regimen.notes: Prescription hormone used under specialist supervision; source explicitly says its research vial does not reproduce depot pharmacokinetics and provides no self-administration regimen.
